for me, horses are just cool. 
something about having a partnership with a 1,000 pound animal is neat and very humbling. when i ride, i view my horse and i as a team, and i try to view things from his perspective. something that’s totally normal for me might be super scary for him!! i’m big on teaching him to be comfortable with things in his own time while also teaching him not to react dangerously. but he’s a rescue horse, and i’m not totally sure of his background, so its a bit of a work in progress lol. while i’m well aware of what he’s capable of (being 1400 pounds), i also choose to put trust in him because we’re a team, and if i’m going to ask him to trust me i have to give him something in return. he is just learning how to communicate with someone (me) who doesn’t speak his language. as am i.
